_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading provider of video, high-speed Internet and phone services (“cable services”) to residential and business customers in the United States' (FY2010 10-K); 'On January 28, 2011, we closed our transaction with General Electric Company (“GE”) in which we acquired control of the businesses of NBC Universal'; 'Competition for the cable services we offer primarily includes direct broadcast satellite (“DBS”) operators and phone companies'; competitors include 'online services that offer Internet video streaming and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'

classification.quality_note: 'We are a leading provider of video, high-speed Internet and phone services (“cable services”) to residential and business customers in the United States' (FY2010 10-K); 'On January 28, 2011, we closed our transaction with General Electric Company (“GE”) in which we acquired control of the businesses of NBC Universal'; 'Competition for the cable services we offer primarily includes direct broadcast satellite (“DBS”) operators and phone companies'; competitors include 'online services that offer Internet video streaming and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.08x; -5% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.27; conservative 2yr +173%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +34.8%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.4-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +34.8%/yr (FY04-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +72.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2011-05-27) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.08x (43.8% downside to Bear $14 / +534.8% upside to Bull $158) | Adj composite 2.49 vs market 1.22: gap +1.27 [UNDERVALUED] | -5% above the EPP floor $26 (20x FY11E $1.31) | Conservative 2-yr case: +173.1% total (+86.5%/yr) | At 19.0x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $33 sits at or below the BASE case; video subscribers -3.0% in Q1 2011, forward revenues +31.8% (no FY11 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2011 revenue growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Comcast FY2010 10-K

sources.title: Comcast Q4 2010 earnings release (8-K, Exhibit 99.1)

sources.title: Comcast FY2009 10-K
